# betterado_serviceendpoint_gitlab (Resource)

Manages a GitLab Service Connection within Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# GitLab service connection using username and password (API token).
resource "betterado_serviceendpoint_gitlab" "example" {
  project_id            = var.project_id
  service_endpoint_name = "my-gitlab"
  username              = "myuser"
  password              = var.gitlab_token
  description           = "GitLab connection"
}

variable "project_id" {
  type = string
}
variable "gitlab_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) The GitLab API token.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.
- `service_endpoint_name` (String) The Service Endpoint name.
- `url` (String) The GitLab server URL.
- `username` (String) The GitLab username.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The Service Endpoint description.

### Read-Only

- `authorization` (Map of String) Specifies the authorization scheme.
- `id` (String) The ID of the service endpoint.
